title: bridelia oblongifolius
intro: Bridelia oblongifolius, commonly known as Erythroxylum oblongifolium or Girei, is a plant species in the family Phyllanthaceae. It is a medicinal plant used for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Bridelia oblongifolius include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
